admissible_claims: descriptive operational variability under independent stock PostgreSQL ANALYZE realizations
within-realization method ranking stability under shared native realization

datasets.cross_dataset_pooling: prohibited; report dataset-scoped strata because Forest10 retains system-freeze-v1

execution_boundary.rq1b_test_access: not used by this protocol; only the RQ4 fixed-k workload/truth binding may be used after formal authorization

failure_rules: stop and preserve append-only failure evidence for missing definitions, payloads, kind mismatch, workload/truth mismatch, cleanup failure or source revision mismatch
stop or qualify if actual OID/relative order cannot be observed; do not infer order from CREATE statement sequence
classify sibling ordinary-statistics or retained-payload mismatch as invalid-control-evidence
never replace a failed realization without recording its failure and applying a predeclared exclusion rule
no formal result is complete unless every declared method arm and every required query observation is present

definitions.query_weighting: the frozen RQ4 workload weighting within each realization

primary_estimand: combined operational impact of independent native ANALYZE realizations under otherwise fixed conditions
prohibited_claims: extended-statistics-only causal decomposition when ordinary statistics also vary
global method superiority or broad probability guarantees from five realizations

method_clones: verify retained payload and ordinary-statistics fingerprints against parent
evaluate identical workload and truth mapping
parent: create union of all selected definitions in lexicographic candidate_id order, matching rq4_physical.union_selected_memberships
record actual object definitions, OIDs, relative OID order, payload bytes/digests and ordinary-statistics fingerprint

realizations.independence: fresh stock parent state and exactly one native ANALYZE per realization
realizations.setseed_policy: may be recorded where required by source setup; never treated as ANALYZE reproducibility control

scientific_questions.SQ1: For fixed membership, quantify native ANALYZE payload, ordinary-statistics, Plan Rows and q-error variability across independent realizations.
scientific_questions.SQ2: Within each shared realization, assess whether method rankings remain stable.
scientific_questions.SQ3: Assess whether realization-induced differences change the interpretation of RQ4b physical comparisons.

secondary_diagnostics: method ranking and paired q-error differences
